summary: Checked the single requested supplement-change slug c450, covering all four paper-level changes (source.supplement_used, not_extracted[16], removal of open_items[11], and notes). The supplement pass changed no estimate fields and added no estimates. Read the complete main-paper markdown and supplement markdown, including references, figures, and the supplementary-file list. Independently extracted main PDF pp. 1, 4-9, and 16-20 and supplement PDF pp. 1-4 with PyMuPDF; also inspected Figures 1-4 as page images rendered in memory. Read the full SPSS file and variable dictionary with pyreadstat. The supplement PDF supplies first-draft instructions and questionnaire excerpts, while the SPSS file supplies participant records and group labels. Neither supplement contains printed arm-summary results, fitted contrasts, analysis-specific exclusion indicators, or imputation identifiers. The SPSS quote "Deepseek Evaluation - Preliminary Draft Average" is an exact variable label. The supplement therefore does not resolve the missing model-specific counts, uncertainty, subdomain evaluator attribution, or scoring-aggregation protocol; no statistics or analysis denominators were calculated from raw records. For main-text integrity, checked all six numerical estimate records against PDF pp. 8-9, including the outcome, AI-follow versus Human-only arms, adjusted analysis, values, and signs. Their statistics also match the earlier raw A extraction. All 28 records in the earlier fixes log still match their logged new records exactly. All four supplement log entries match the current fields, and the main-paper portion of the updated notes preserves its numerical content. Reviewed the specified coding fields across the 54 existing records: the AI-first final draft is after_ai with outcome_with_ai false; AI-assisted stages are with_ai; timing is immediate; assignment is between participants, so within_person is null; human and DeepSeek evaluations remain distinct, with the numerical subdomain evaluator unspecified. Analysis counts remain null because the valid-case pool does not identify the cases retained for each fitted model or figure. Figure-only records correctly contain no transcribed numerical results. All ten mechanical quote warnings are false positives: "AI-parallel assistance, where both drafts were developed" ends main PDF p. 6 and "collaboratively with AI;" begins p. 7. The recorded quotation matches exactly after removing the intervening page footer and normalizing whitespace, and the pp. 6-7 locator is correct. The preserved reconciliation inventory in the notes is historical and is explicitly superseded by the earlier fixes log. No problem was found in the requested supplement changes or in preservation of the main-text numbers.
